dedupe_keys.name: aer facility and facility cost centre listing

description: The source family lists natural-gas reference codes for Alberta Energy Regulator facilities and facility cost centres, alongside transportation regions and plant/plan class and type codes. Each package lists one spreadsheet. These are complementary identifiers and classification tables for gas-system facilities. The source title says Plan Class, while the distribution filename says Plant Class; that wording difference remains unresolved. The inspected metadata does not establish field definitions, coordinates, facility capacities or effective dates. Cost-centre and classification codes are not counted as separate physical facilities. The CUDC source records name the Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, present file access and numerical contents are unverified. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless identified above. No workbook, document or linked data body was fetched. Geographic coverage is Alberta.
